topic: Station restrictions, RACES, space and telecommand stations

questions.question: Which of the following constitutes a spurious emission?

choices.A: An amateur station transmission made without the proper call sign identification
choices.B: A signal transmitted to prevent its detection by any station other than the intended recipient
choices.C: Any transmitted signal that unintentionally interferes with another licensed radio station and whose levels exceed 40 dB below the fundamental power level
choices.D: An emission outside the signal’s necessary bandwidth that can be reduced or eliminated without affecting the information transmitted

questions.answer: An emission outside the signal’s necessary bandwidth that can be reduced or eliminated without affecting the information transmitted

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable bandwidth for digital voice or slow-scan TV transmissions made on the HF amateur bands?

choices.A: 3 kHz
choices.B: 10 kHz
choices.C: 15 kHz

questions.answer: 3 kHz

questions.question: Within what distance must an amateur station protect an FCC monitoring facility from harmful interference?

choices.A: 1 mile
choices.B: 3 miles
choices.C: 10 miles

questions.answer: 1 mile

questions.question: What must the control operator of a repeater operating in the 70-centimeter band do if a radiolocation system experiences interference from that repeater?

choices.A: Reduce the repeater antenna HAAT (Height Above Average Terrain)
choices.B: File an FAA NOTAM (Notice to Air Missions) with the repeater system's ERP, call sign, and six-character grid locator
choices.C: Cease operation or make changes to the repeater that mitigate the interference

questions.answer: Cease operation or make changes to the repeater that mitigate the interference

questions.question: What is the National Radio Quiet Zone?

choices.A: An area surrounding the FCC monitoring station in Laurel, Maryland
choices.B: An area in New Mexico surrounding the White Sands Test Area
choices.C: An area surrounding the National Radio Astronomy Observatory
choices.D: An area in Florida surrounding Cape Canaveral

questions.answer: An area surrounding the National Radio Astronomy Observatory

questions.question: Which of the following additional rules apply if you are erecting an amateur station antenna structure at a site at or near a public use airport?

choices.A: You may have to notify the Federal Aviation Administration and register it with the FCC as required by Part 17 of the FCC rules
choices.B: You may have to enter the height above ground in meters, and the latitude and longitude in degrees, minutes, and seconds on the FAA website
choices.C: You must file an Environmental Impact Statement with the EPA before construction begins
choices.D: You must obtain a construction permit from the airport zoning authority per Part 119 of the FAA regulations

questions.answer: You may have to notify the Federal Aviation Administration and register it with the FCC as required by Part 17 of the FCC rules

questions.question: To what type of regulations does PRB-1 apply?

choices.A: Homeowners associations
choices.B: FAA tower height limits
choices.C: State and local zoning
choices.D: Use of wireless devices in vehicles

questions.answer: State and local zoning

questions.question: What limitations may the FCC place on an amateur station if its signal causes interference to domestic broadcast reception, assuming that the receivers involved are of good engineering design?

choices.A: The amateur station must cease operation
choices.B: The amateur station must cease operation on all frequencies below 30 MHz
choices.C: The amateur station must cease operation on all frequencies above 30 MHz
choices.D: The amateur station must avoid transmitting during certain hours on frequencies that cause the interference

questions.answer: The amateur station must avoid transmitting during certain hours on frequencies that cause the interference

questions.question: Which amateur stations may be operated under RACES rules?

choices.A: Only those club stations licensed to Amateur Extra class operators
choices.B: Any FCC-licensed amateur station except a Technician class
choices.C: Any FCC-licensed amateur station certified by the responsible civil defense organization for the area served
choices.D: Only stations meeting the FCC Part 97 technical standards for operation during an emergency

questions.answer: Any FCC-licensed amateur station certified by the responsible civil defense organization for the area served

questions.question: What frequencies are authorized to an amateur station operating under RACES rules?

choices.A: All amateur service frequencies authorized to the control operator
choices.B: Specific segments in the amateur service MF, HF, VHF, and UHF bands
choices.C: Specific local government channels

questions.answer: All amateur service frequencies authorized to the control operator

questions.question: What does PRB-1 require of state and local regulations affecting amateur radio antenna size and structures?

choices.A: No limitations may be placed on antenna size or placement
choices.B: Reasonable accommodations of amateur radio must be made
choices.C: Such structures must be permitted when use for emergency communications can be demonstrated
choices.D: Such structures must be permitted if certified by a registered professional engineer

questions.answer: Reasonable accommodations of amateur radio must be made

questions.question: What is the definition of telemetry?

choices.A: One-way transmission of measurements at a distance from the measuring instrument
choices.B: Two-way transmissions in excess of 1000 feet
choices.C: Two-way transmissions of data
choices.D: One-way transmission that initiates, modifies, or terminates the functions of a device at a distance

questions.answer: One-way transmission of measurements at a distance from the measuring instrument

questions.question: Which of the following may transmit encrypted messages?

choices.A: Telecommand signals to terrestrial repeaters
choices.B: Telecommand signals from a space telecommand station
choices.C: Auxiliary relay links carrying repeater audio

questions.answer: Telecommand signals from a space telecommand station

questions.question: What is a space telecommand station?

choices.A: An amateur station located on the surface of the Earth for communication with other Earth stations by means of Earth satellites
choices.B: An amateur station that transmits communications to initiate, modify, or terminate functions of a space station
choices.C: An amateur station located in a satellite or a balloon more than 50 kilometers above the surface of the Earth
choices.D: An amateur station that receives telemetry from a satellite or balloon more than 50 kilometers above the surface of the Earth

questions.answer: An amateur station that transmits communications to initiate, modify, or terminate functions of a space station

questions.question: Which of the following is required in the identification transmissions from a balloon-borne telemetry station?

choices.A: Call sign
choices.B: The output power of the balloon transmitter
choices.C: The station's six-character Maidenhead grid locator

questions.answer: Call sign

questions.question: What must be posted at the location of a station being operated by telecommand on or within 50 kilometers of the Earth’s surface?

choices.A: A photocopy of the station license
choices.B: A label with the name, address, and telephone number of the station licensee
choices.C: A label with the name, address, and telephone number of the control operator

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: What is the maximum permitted transmitter output power when operating a model craft by telecommand?

choices.A: 1 watt
choices.B: 2 watts
choices.C: 5 watts

questions.answer: 1 watt

questions.question: Which of the following HF amateur bands include allocations for space stations?

choices.A: 40 meters, 20 meters, 15 meters, and 10 meters
choices.B: 30 meters, 17 meters, and 10 meters
choices.C: Only 10 meters
choices.D: Satellite operation is permitted on all HF bands

questions.answer: 40 meters, 20 meters, 15 meters, and 10 meters

questions.question: Which VHF amateur bands have frequencies authorized for space stations?

choices.A: 6 meters and 2 meters
choices.B: 6 meters, 2 meters, and 1.25 meters
choices.C: 2 meters and 1.25 meters

questions.answer: 2 meters

questions.question: Which UHF amateur bands have frequencies authorized for space stations?

choices.A: 70 centimeters only
choices.B: 70 centimeters and 13 centimeters
choices.C: 70 centimeters and 33 centimeters

questions.answer: 70 centimeters and 13 centimeters

questions.question: Which amateur stations are eligible to be telecommand stations of space stations, subject to the privileges of the class of operator license held by the control operator of the station?

choices.A: Any amateur station approved by AMSAT
choices.B: Any amateur station so designated by the space station licensee
choices.C: Any amateur station so designated by the ITU

questions.answer: Any amateur station so designated by the space station licensee

questions.question: Which amateur stations are eligible to operate as Earth stations?

choices.A: Any amateur licensee who has successfully completed the AMSAT space communications course
choices.B: Only those of General, Advanced or Amateur Extra class operators
choices.C: Only those of Amateur Extra class operators
choices.D: Any amateur station, subject to the privileges of the class of operator license held by the control operator

questions.answer: Any amateur station, subject to the privileges of the class of operator license held by the control operator

questions.question: Which of the following amateur stations may transmit one-way communications?

choices.A: A space station, beacon station, or telecommand station
choices.B: A local repeater or linked repeater station
choices.C: A message forwarding station or automatically controlled digital station

questions.answer: A space station, beacon station, or telecommand station
